summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 gap closure execution (plan 23-08: WinFsp extraction to crate), then run a security review on the Rust SDK changes, fix findings, increase Rust test coverage to address Codecov feedback, and get PR #352 merged-ready.
summary.outcome: All goals achieved: Phase 23 gap closure committed, security review generated with 2 HIGH findings fixed (Ed25519 zeroization + ed25519-dalek zeroize feature), 181 lines of dead code removed, 163 new unit tests added across 3 crates (168 total passing), CI failures fixed (vendored fuser build.rs on Windows + pnpm version), and a copy-paste bug in registry.rs fixed via PR review resolution.

repo: The workspace-level [patch.crates-io] for vendored fuser applies to all members including on Windows builds, causing fuser's build.rs to run even when fuser isn't a transitive dependency — requires explicit early-return on cfg(target_os = 'windows')
CI collects Rust coverage via `cargo llvm-cov --workspace` on Linux; any tests added to workspace crates are automatically included
KeyState and CipherBoxFS key fields already use Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> consistently, but generate_ed25519_keypair returned bare Vec<u8> — callers were wrapping in Zeroizing::new() redundantly
ed25519-dalek's SigningKey only zeroes on drop when the 'zeroize' feature is explicitly enabled in Cargo.toml
Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> does not implement TryInto<[u8; 32]> directly — callers converting to fixed-size arrays must use Vec::from(zeroizing_val).try_into()
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking existed in both macOS/Linux and Windows operations.rs but had zero external callers — pure dead code
The pnpm setup action in CI requires an explicit version: field; other jobs used version: 10

code.finding: generate_ed25519_keypair returned (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) — private key not in Zeroizing wrapper, leaving key material in freed memory after drop
ed25519-dalek dependency was missing the 'zeroize' feature flag at workspace level
Callers of generate_ed25519_keypair were wrapping return value in Zeroizing::new(...clone()) — redundant double-wrapping after return type fix
ipns_private_key.try_into() for Vec<u8> -> [u8; 32] needed Vec::from() unwrap when value became Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking were dead code — no external callers in either platform path
Vendored fuser build.rs called unimplemented!() on non-Linux without libfuse feature, causing Windows cargo check to fail even when fuser is not a transitive dependency
Copy-paste bug: manifest.app_version was set to device_info.device_id instead of app_version; fields were already partially moved so fix required storing app_version before the move

workflow: When a subagent disconnects mid-execution, spot-checking via git log --oneline and file existence checks can confirm which tasks completed before resuming bookkeeping manually
Parallel subagent execution for independent test-writing tasks (crypto/core/sdk crates) saved significant wall-clock time with no coordination overhead
The security:review command scope question (Specific files / Recent changes / Phase code / Full audit) effectively scoped the review to Phase 23's 5 crates
Codecov PR comments are a useful trigger for identifying untested code — addressing them proactively before merge avoids future coverage debt
resolve-pr-comments workflow correctly identified a copy-paste bug (device_id used instead of app_version) that automated reviewer caught

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent failed 3 consecutive times mid-session, requiring the user to retry manually after returning from AFK
The subagent API connection dropped mid-execution (ConnectionRefused) for the initial 23-08 executor agent, requiring manual resume and bookkeeping
CI job log extraction via gh run view required multiple attempts to isolate actual compiler errors from download noise
Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> TryInto<[u8; 32]> incompatibility required identifying all call sites that used .try_into() on the return value — not surfaced until compile time
open_items: AES-CTR lacks client-side CID integrity verification after fetch — HIGH finding from security review, not fixed in this session (deferred)
file_ipns_private_key in write_ops.rs uses ed25519_dalek SigningKey directly (not through generate_ed25519_keypair) — key material handling not reviewed/fixed in this session
fuse crate still has pre-existing dead code warnings from vendored fuser and other sources — not addressed (pre-existing, out of scope)
Security review generated ~30 test case suggestions for AES-GCM, ECIES, HKDF etc. — only a subset were implemented as actual tests; attack scenario tests (replay, timing) not yet written
Codecov will report new coverage numbers after CI runs — may still have gaps in fuse crate (platform-specific code difficult to unit test without FUSE environment)
